scene.prompt: Thebes on the Nile in the Egyptian New Kingdom: temples of Karnak and Luxor on the east bank, mortuary temples and the cliffs of the Valley of the Kings on the west bank, mud-brick houses, palm groves, papyrus boats
Memphis, the great administrative city of New Kingdom Egypt: the temple of Ptah, busy Nile harbour of Peru-nefer with cargo ships, white walls, the old pyramids of Saqqara and Giza on the desert edge
Kassite Babylon on the Euphrates, Late Bronze Age: mud-brick city walls and gates, the temple of Marduk Esagila and its ziggurat, date palms along irrigation canals, reed boats
The city of Assur on a rocky bluff above the Tigris, Middle Assyrian period: the temple of the god Ashur, ziggurat, royal palace, city walls, steppe and barley fields beyond the river
